summary: Completed testing of 'Popular Right Now' feature - GET /api/popular/now endpoint and PopularNow.jsx component. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed - section renders correctly below search form, cards display with proper data-testids, deep-link navigation works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper separation of concerns between API and UI
Badge logic (LEAVES SOON when minutes_until_departure <= 120) correctly implemented
Seats color logic (red when seats_available <= 10) correctly implemented
Deep-link navigation includes all required params (from, to, date, adults=1, children=0)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Popular Now feature fully tested. Backend endpoint /api/popular/now returns up to 6 items with proper structure (generated_at, items array). Each item includes from_city, to_city, from_terminal, to_terminal, schedule_id, departure_date, departure_time, arrival_time, is_today, minutes_until_departure, fare, currency, seats_available. Sorting is correct (today items first, then by minutes_until_departure). Frontend PopularNow.jsx renders cards with data-testid='popular-now-{from_city}-{to_city}' format. Clicking cards navigates to /search with correct URL params.

backend: Default limit returns up to 6 items
limit=3 parameter caps response to 3 items

Each item has all required keys (from_city, to_city, from_terminal, to_terminal, schedule_id, departure_date, departure_time, arrival_time, is_today, minutes_until_departure, fare, currency, seats_available)
from_terminal and to_terminal have proper structure (id, city, name, code)
minutes_until_departure is non-negative integer or null
seats_available is non-negative integer (total_seats - locked/booked count)
Sorting: is_today=true items come before non-today items
Within same is_today group, sorted by minutes_until_departure ascending
fare is numeric, currency is valid (myr/sgd)
departure_time and arrival_time in HH:MM format
Edge cases: limit=0 returns at least 1, limit=100 capped at 12
frontend: Home page renders [data-testid='popular-now-section'] below search form
Section renders N cards matching API response
Badge shows 'TODAY' (black bg) when is_today=true and minutes > 120
Badge shows 'LEAVES SOON' (red bg) when is_today=true and minutes <= 120 (logic verified in code)
Seats shown in red when seats_available <= 10 (logic verified in code)
Section hidden when API returns empty items (conditional render in code)
Regression: existing 'Popular routes' section still renders below (data-testid='popular-routes-section')
